kebab_example: aliyun hbr describe-recoverable-ots-instances --cross-account-type CROSS_ACCOUNT --cross-account-user-id 1440155109798732 --cross-account-role-name hbrcrossrole --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRecoverableOtsInstances

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account or across Alibaba Cloud accounts. Valid values:

SELF_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account.
CROSS_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份 
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source Alibaba Cloud account that authorizes the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号的原账号的阿里云Uid
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) role that is created within the source Alibaba Cloud account and assigned to the current Alibaba Cloud account to authorize the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name
